title: [Subcontracting] Add quantity-ready-to-start tracking for production routing operations
summary: Production order routing operations now track quantity ready to start, showing how much output from preceding operations is available for the next step. The calculation respects send-ahead quantities and thresholds, and can optionally filter subcontracting worksheet proposals to exclude operations not yet ready.
key_points: New read-only Quantity Ready to Start field on production routing lines
Calculation respects send-ahead quantities, thresholds, parallel routings and production families
Readiness maintained during routing calculation, planning, output posting and order reopening
Optional filter added to Calculate Subcontracts report to exclude unready operations
New columns hidden by default; subcontracting filter is optional to preserve backward compatibility
